one_line: Thanjavur’s shrewd Nayaka ruler who negotiated the Tranquebar treaty with the Danish East India Company.

appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown complexion, neatly trimmed black moustache, sharp thoughtful eyes with a calm, calculating gaze, default expression composed and slightly confident
appearance.hair: black hair parted at center and pulled back into a short knotted bun at the back of the head, covered by a tall conical Thanjavur-style royal turban in deep maroon silk with a narrow gold band and a single small white plume at the front
appearance.costume: long-sleeved cream-coloured cotton angarkha-style upper robe crossing left over right and tied at the side, falling to mid-thigh; beneath it a rich deep-maroon silk waist sash wrapped twice around and knotted at the left hip; full-length off-white cotton dhoti with a broad maroon border and thin gold stripe, pleated neatly in front and wrapped to the ankles; simple brown leather sandals; ornamentation limited to a single gold chain around the neck, a pair of modest gold karnai earrings, and two thin gold bangles on each wrist; fabric is plain with subtle woven texture, no heavy embroidery, reflecting a practical but royal Nayaka court style.
appearance.signature: rolled palm-leaf treaty scroll bound with a red silk tie held in his left hand, symbolising his diplomatic control of coastal treaties

ref_desc: Raghunatha Nayaka has an oval medium-brown face with a black moustache, a deep-maroon conical turban, a cream angarkha, maroon sash, off-white dhoti, simple gold jewellery and sandals, always holding a rolled palm-leaf treaty scroll in deep maroon, cream and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Raghunatha Nayaka standing front-facing: an early-40s Thanjavur ruler with an oval medium-brown face, sharp thoughtful eyes and a neat black moustache, black hair tied in a short back knot under a tall deep-maroon conical royal turban with a narrow gold band and a small white plume. He wears a long-sleeved cream cotton angarkha-style upper robe crossing left over right and tied at the side, over a deep-maroon silk waist sash wrapped twice and knotted at his left hip. His off-white cotton dhoti has a broad maroon border with a thin gold stripe, pleated neatly in front and wrapped to his ankles, paired with simple brown leather sandals. Adorn him with one gold chain at the neck, modest gold earrings and two thin gold bangles on each wrist. In his left hand he firmly holds a rolled palm-leaf treaty scroll bound with a red silk tie. Keep the colours dominated by deep maroon, cream, off-white, gold and brown, and show him clearly head-to-toe so this design can be reused consistently.
